title: ‘연결 미확인’ 재현과 현재 세션 확인 범위
blockedReason: Native 실행 요약이며 업무 수용·독립 검토는 별도입니다.

commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '85,220p' src/chat-state.ts; sed -n '420,485p' src/renderer.tsx; rg -n 'belongsToConversation|transcriptState|reset.*Events|transport/status' src/renderer.tsx src/chat-state.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rg --files --hidden "$HOME/Library/Application Support/www" | rg '"'activity|event|session|log' | head -45; rg -n 'publish\\(|MAX_.*EVENT|slice\\(-|transport/status' src/native-session.ts | head -65; rg -n '연결 미확인|issues/4' docs/work/INDEX.md docs/work --glob 'spec.md' | head -15"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat 'docs/work/Native/016-답변 스트리밍 중 ‘연결 미확인’ 버그 재현 및 등록/spec.md'
sed -n '264,286p' src/native-session.ts
sed -n '36,58p' src/chat-state.ts
gh issue view 4 --repo woo-jongho/www --json comments --jq '.comments | length'
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,json,collections
d=pathlib.Path.home()/'.codex/sessions/2026/11/22'
matches=[]
for f in sorted(d.glob('*.jsonl'),key=lambda x:x.stat().st_mtime,reverse=True)[:15]:
 if '지금 여기 세션도 연결미확인뜨네' in f.read_text(): matches.append(f)
for f in matches[:1]:
 print(f.name)
 counts=collections.Counter()
 for l in f.open():
  x=json.loads(l);p=x.get('payload',{})
  if x.get('type')=='event_msg': counts[p.get('type')]+=1
 print(counts)
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '18,27p' src/main.ts
sed -n '600,667p' src/renderer.tsx
sed -n '772,805p' src/native-session.ts
rg -n 'getAppState|stateFor|onNativeEvent|eventsSnapshot' src/{main.ts,native-session.ts,preload.ts}
ps -axo pid,comm | rg -i 'Electron|Codex|/www' | head -25
rg -n 'project\\(events\\)|project\\(' src/renderer.tsx | tail -10"
